Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lakeville for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. The season runs from December 3 (No Nose for Rudolph puppet show at the Arts Center) through December 12, with the Holiday on Main Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 4), the free Holiday on Main with Santa and trolley rides (December 5) and Santa's Coming to Breakfast at Tinsel Tavern (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
